scope: Normalized FIFA Big Count 2006 'All Players' observations from the checked-in 208-row All Players extract.
limitations: The checked-in extract cannot recover country-level male/female splits or per-cell FIFA statistical-processing flags. FIFA's methodology supplemented missing association responses with prior surveys and internal analysis. Cross-country field definitions are not assumed identical. Earth/geopolitical identity mapping is a separate reviewed transformation and is not embedded in source facts.
